_comment: Per-metric noise thresholds (percent) for bench-e2e-diff.py. A row is colored only when the median same-machine pair delta exceeds its threshold with directional agreement. Initial values are hypotheses; recalibrate from nightly A/A runs via `bench-e2e-diff.py --calibrate <dir of downloaded A/A results trees>` and land the suggested values here as a reviewed PR.
